blockMcqs.question: What does trie insert and search time depend on?
options: The depth of the deepest word
blockMcqs.explanation: You take one step per character, so the word count never enters the cost.

blockMcqs.question: You need autocomplete over a word list. Best structure?
blockMcqs.explanation: Only a trie builds the prefix relationship into the layout itself.

blockMcqs.question: Why does a trie node need an isEnd flag?
options: To count how many children it has
A node can end a word and still have children
blockMcqs.explanation: Leaf detection fails when a word is a prefix of a longer stored word.

blockMcqs.question: How does startsWith differ from search in a trie?
options: It also checks the isEnd flag
It only needs the prefix node to exist
It walks the trie in reverse
It returns the matched word count
blockMcqs.explanation: Reaching the end of the prefix is enough; word termination is irrelevant.

blockMcqs.question: In KMP, what stays fixed when the pattern mismatches?
blockMcqs.explanation: Only the pattern slides via lps; never rewinding text gives the linear bound.

blockMcqs.question: Why must Rabin–Karp verify characters on a hash match?
options: Rolling the hash loses precision over time
Different strings can share the same hash
To reset the rolling hash state
blockMcqs.explanation: Hash collisions make equal hashes a necessary but not sufficient condition.

blockMcqs.question: Which algorithm guarantees linear time on adversarial input?
blockMcqs.explanation: Rabin–Karp is only average linear; it degrades to O(n·m) on heavy collisions.

blockMcqs.question: How do routers perform longest-prefix IP match?
options: Hash table keyed by full address
blockMcqs.explanation: A hash can answer exact match but cannot rank entries by shared prefix length.

blockMcqs.question: What does lps[i] measure in the KMP failure function?
options: Whether any prefix repeats in the pattern
Longest proper prefix that is also a suffix
The number of matches found so far
The distance to the next mismatch
blockMcqs.explanation: Both 'proper' and 'also a suffix' are load-bearing for the slide length.
